description: This file is a React component named UsagePage that renders a usage dashboard with multiple charts, tables, and data fetching logic. It manages state, fetches various usage metrics from network APIs, and organizes the UI within tabs and grids.

classes.name: UsagePageProps
classes.description: Props interface for UsagePage component, defining access tokens, user role, user ID, available keys, and user type.

classes.name: GlobalActivityData
classes.description: Interface representing global activity metrics including total API requests, total tokens, and daily data breakdown.

classes.name: CustomTooltipTypeBar
classes.description: Type definition for the custom tooltip used in charts, containing payload, active state, and label.

methods.name: customTooltip
methods.description: Renders a custom tooltip for bar charts showing top models' values as dollar amounts.

methods.name: getTopKeys
methods.description: Processes an array of data objects to find top 5 keys based on spend, excluding specific keys.

methods.name: isAdminOrAdminViewer
methods.description: Checks if the user role is 'Admin' or 'Admin Viewer' for access rights.

methods.name: UsagePage
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering usage dashboards, fetching data, and managing state.

methods.name: fetchProxySettings
methods.description: Fetches proxy UI settings asynchronously.

methods.name: updateEndUserData
methods.description: Fetches and updates end user data for a given date range.

methods.name: updateTagSpendData
methods.description: Fetches and updates spend data categorized by tags for a given date range.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object as 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.

methods.name: fetchAndSetData
methods.description: Helper function to perform data fetching with error handling and set state.

methods.name: fillMissingDates
methods.description: Fills in missing dates in data arrays with zero values across a date range, standardizing date formats.

methods.name: fetchOverallSpend
methods.description: Fetches overall spend logs, fills missing dates, and updates total monthly spend state.

methods.name: fetchProviderSpend
methods.description: Fetches spend data categorized by providers.

methods.name: fetchTopKeys
methods.description: Fetches top API keys.

methods.name: fetchTopModels
methods.description: Fetches top models based on spend.

methods.name: fetchTeamSpend
methods.description: Fetches spend per team and fills missing dates for visualization.

methods.name: fetchTagNames
methods.description: Fetches all available tag names for filtering.

methods.name: fetchTopTags
methods.description: Fetches spend data categorized by tags.

methods.name: fetchTopEndUsers
methods.description: Fetches top end user data.

methods.name: fetchGlobalActivity
methods.description: Fetches global API activity data, including daily request and token counts, filling missing dates.

methods.name: fetchGlobalActivityPerModel
methods.description: Fetches per-model API activity data, filling missing dates.

methods.name: UsagePage (useEffect initialization)
methods.description: Initializes data fetching on mount, considering proxy settings and user roles.
